page.title: Terroir
page.meta_description: Terroir is the idea that a vineyard is not interchangeable. Burgundy made it doctrine; New World producers now argue it in their own dirt. Related pages:…
page.content:
Taste of place — soil, climate, slope, and human habit in the glass.

How Terroir connects

  • Topic: Wine — Terroir is the idea that wine tastes of a particular place.
  • Location: Burgundy — Burgundy's climats made terroir the central language of fine wine.
  • Topic: AOC — AOC writes terroir into maps and permitted grapes.
  • Item: Riesling — Riesling is often cited as a grape that broadcasts site and sweetness clearly.
  • Topic: Vintage — Vintage is the yearly weather chapter of a place's terroir.

What is Terroir?

Terroir is the idea that a vineyard is not interchangeable. Burgundy made it doctrine; New World producers now argue it in their own dirt.

Key threads lead to Wine, Burgundy, AOC, Riesling and Vintage.
